segments.text:
V. 2.
Jeſus and his diſciples were invited to the marriage—Chriſt does not take away human Society, but ſanctify it. Water might have quenched Thirſt; yet our LORD allows Wine; eſpecially at a feſtival Solemnity. Such was his Facility in drawing his Diſciples at firſt, who were afterwards to go thro' rougher Ways.
